generated_on_the_fly_policy.allowed: Source-required nonrecurring civilians/guards/operators/clinical patients, with correct population, age/role, current era and inherited wardrobe. Mixed populations by person, not city.
generated_on_the_fly_policy.forbidden: Named-character substitute, generic Council voter, merging two commanders/families or creating recurring face without continuity record.

generated_on_the_fly_policy.allowed: Unmarked ordinary food/water, cloths, loose paper, flowers, practical gifts and repair clutter only where source supports them.
generated_on_the_fly_policy.forbidden: Charged travel charm, returned command seal, invented epitaph, new logo or new plot-bearing object.

generated_on_the_fly_policy.allowed: New views of existing canonical designs, source-required dirt/repair/charge/wardrobe changes, maintain a scene state log.
generated_on_the_fly_policy.forbidden: Redesign known face, identify all Academy visitors as cadets, reset source age or infer unprovided injury side.

generated_on_the_fly_policy.allowed: Script-specific mana-eye changes, aperture inactive/active variation, warm ambient light, judgment light, historical/subjective overlays.
generated_on_the_fly_policy.forbidden: Mana after zero, premature reveals, spell from infant, spectator sees private thought, recharging passenger.

generated_on_the_fly_policy.allowed: Only source-described historical playback/evidence and maps constrained by canonical geography. Apply correct depicted world style.
generated_on_the_fly_policy.forbidden: New altered-past event, fabricated statistics, new diegetic English translation or unapproved glyph string.

generated_on_the_fly_policy.allowed: Nonrecurring road/clinic/checkpoint/shelter/neighbor views derived from current Nyas/Zora geography/material canon, and memorial view constrained by source marker/flowers with no invented inscription.
generated_on_the_fly_policy.forbidden: Substitute Temple Hospital for North Hospital, small observation balloon for carrier, WOA for Council, new dimensions/route time/weather asserted as canon.
